featured_reviews.name: Jitu Shelar
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently had the opportunity to receive care at Central Hospital for my mother, and I would like to express my sincere appreciation for the exceptional service and compassion demonstrated by the entire staff. From the moment we arrived, we were welcomed with warmth and professionalism.

The medical team at Central Hospital is truly outstanding. The doctors took the time to clearly explain my mother’s diagnosis and treatment options, answering all of our questions with patience and expertise. Their thoroughness and dedication to my mother’s well-being gave us great confidence and peace of mind throughout her stay.

The nurses and support staff consistently went above and beyond to ensure her comfort. They were attentive, responsive, and treated her with genuine kindness and respect. Their caring attitude and positive demeanor made a significant difference in her recovery process.

We are deeply grateful to everyone at Central Hospital for their dedication, compassion, and professionalism. I wholeheartedly recommend this hospital to anyone seeking high-quality healthcare delivered with empathy and excellence. Thank you for making a difficult time much easier through your outstanding care.

featured_reviews.name: Vishwas Pawar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I really thank Central hospital and it's staff for the excellent care taken while in hospital for 5 days.  I never felt like i was in hospital i felt like i m at home.
Excellent hygiene , cleanliness, nursing staff was with professional approach. Dressing was pain less inspite the injury was quite big.

Special thanks to Dr Sunil, Dr Amit, Dr Manish, Dr Gauri for providing true professional and friendly guidance and performing such a long surgery in such a way that i hardly felt any pain even during surgery and after surgery when anesthesia effect was gone. My surgery was at wrist which was bit risky but Central hospital did  the job in perfection

I stay at Kalyan but still i did surgery here because the cost given at Kalyan was much higher than at central hospital.

I highly recommend central hospital for surgery in terms of cost and excellent approach of Doctors, staff, cleanliness, Hygiene.

featured_reviews.name: prakash raut

Thank you to everyone at Central Hospital. You not only treated the illness but also treated us with humanity. Truly grateful 🙏
Highly recommended to anyone seeking quality and compassionate care.
